title: Saturday, asked
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Tuesday. The Owner asks about Saturday. She asks it as a scheduling question. Wood says he's working Saturday. She says the shop's closed Saturday. He says he'll open it.

panels.composition: The frame shop. The OWNER at the calendar on the wall, pen up. WOOD at the counter.

panels.composition: The calendar. Saturday: CLOSED, printed. Her pen over it.
